scope: All five retained EMA rows with exact L04AC07; full product cohort, not all tocilizumab products worldwide or all current EMA medicines.
question: Which directed same-ATC medicine candidates cover an explicitly recorded administration route, and which distinctions disappear under a parenteral-family projection?
prior_knowledge: RoActemra IV and SC formulations known from official search. Other cohort documents not inspected. Existing Swiss route findings known. Locally prospective transfer specification, not external preregistration.
new_context: EU medicine-to-medicine recorded-route coverage, compared with Swiss authorization-to-tariff route support. No clinical substitution or Swiss eligibility target.
field_scope: All complete label section 5 route fields bound to preceding label section 1 product title and closing section 6 warning heading; field 1 on small containers is excluded and counted separately where observable.
positive_field_lines: Standalone positive route declarations with optional for, only or after preparation qualifier; negative and conditional declarations withheld. Existing section-4.2 assertion matcher unchanged and compared at medicine-route set level.
primary_candidate_unit: Directed source medicine, different target medicine, source documented route; require same exact staged ATC. Every primary candidate retained.
exact_decision: VERIFIED when target label inventory explicitly includes source route; CONTRADICTED when target has a nonempty complete declared route inventory with disjoint recorded routes; UNDETERMINED when source or target inventory unavailable. Target is documentary route inventory membership, not clinical suitability.
coarse_decision: IV,SC,IM,IT project to parenteral; O to oral. Same decision rule applied to projected inventories.
checks: Complete cohort retrieval/accounting including failed documents
EMA SmPC ATC field comparison for every cohort medicine
Native graph and independent relational candidate-set agreement
Label removal produces unavailable assessments, not conflict
interpretation: Route absence in this complete scoped label census is documentary noncoverage, not an assertion that treatment substitution is contraindicated or that approval elsewhere is absent.
